findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_commodity_codes" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_procurement_portals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
